title: Active session counts via CTE
description: Use a CTE to first count active_sessions for each database_name using only state = active. Then return databases with at least 2 active_sessions. Return exactly two columns: database_name, active_sessions. Sort by active_sessions DESC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
WITH active_counts AS (
  SELECT database_name
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT *
FROM active_counts
hints: Perform WHERE + GROUP BY inside the CTE and apply the threshold outside.
The CTE should already expose active_sessions.
solution_explanation: The CTE separates active-session aggregation from final filtering.
